status: Adaptive follow-up after observing the four matched packed-GLiDE scores on the first 16 shared judgments. Reuse the same case split for a representation ablation, not fresh confirmation.
data: Use the 12 preselected complete training judgments (357 sentences), and every nonblank sentence from the same 16 shared validation judgments (3,558). Choose no new coefficients on this validation set.
base: Pinned GLiDE source, FP32 reference, unchanged 8-sentence token grouping/prefix/fixed options. Previously stored tensors cover only the identical answer-cue position for each sentence. The actual words' final contextualized vectors were never retained.
fixed_candidates: CPU contextual control. For each cue, subtract the mean of the other answer-cue vectors in its block and restore the mean of all training cue vectors. For a true singleton block use the original cue. Apply the identical zero-gradient existing seven-row ridge write; no other learned parameters.

CPU lexical control. Look up the original GLiDE BF16 token embedding vectors of the actual target sentence, run the original embedding LayerNorm, and take their mean before any transformer block. Exclude tokens spanning whitespace only, all options, and all answer cues. Fit the same existing seven-readout-row ridge write. This measures static lexical information and is distinct from contextualized pooling.

GPU contextualized content arm. Run the original FP32 encoder on precisely the same token IDs, full attention masks, and 51+460 blocks used for the cue study. Gather every actual sentence-content token after the last encoder layer/normalization; take the unweighted mean for each sentence. Train the same native seven-row write. Verify original cue vectors on the same pass and assert each chosen token is really part of the target text. This requires a new forward pass. Wait for root authorization for an Intel GPU window.

Diagnostic negative control for each representation: keep the written head unchanged and cyclically exchange features between adjacent targets within each block at evaluation. Also retain label-shuffled weight writes and the untouched readout on the same representation.
fixed_head_recipe: Same as the primary study: weighted ridge residual with lambda 0.15, target margin 4, inverse-square-root training frequencies and existing BF16 255-by-1024 native code tensor. Modify only its first seven rows. No model selection on these 16 judgments.
plaintext_content: Use the same tokenizer on newline then original sentence text. A content-token offset must overlap a genuine non-whitespace character from that sentence. Punctuation counts. The fixed answer cue, prefix, CLS, SEP and padding are excluded.
further_confirmation: Any candidate earning a comparable score to the incumbent requires case-disjoint subsequent confirmation under a frozen decision rule, with no claim from this adaptive 16-case replay alone.
